bio: Nestled within the picturesque village of Crawforsburn, The Old Inn exudes old-world charm and quaint familiarity, making it the perfect setting for a traditional Afternoon Tea experience. Transport yourself back in time with a classic Afternoon Tea, featuring a selection of freshly baked treats in a charming hotel setting.  The Restaurant, adorned with vintage decor and cosy vibes, invites guests to relax and unwind in a rustic yet elegant ambience that is reminiscent of a bygone era. The friendly and attentive service adds to the welcoming atmosphere, creating a sense of warmth and hospitality that complements the overall dining experience.  The Afternoon Tea menu at The Old Inn offers a delectable assortment of treats that cater to both sweet and savoury palates. Guests can expect to savour freshly baked scones served with clotted cream and jam, delicate finger sandwiches with a variety of fillings, and an array of indulgent pastries and sweets. Complementing these delightful offerings is an option for adding on Champagne or cocktails, ensuring that every guest finds a perfect pairing to enhance their experience.  Whether you're seeking a relaxing afternoon outing with loved ones or simply looking to treat yourself to a moment of indulgence, this century-old tradition at The Old Inn promises a memorable and satisfying dining experience that is steeped in history and culinary delight.  Afternoon Tea is served daily from 12pm - 5pm. Please note Afternoon Tea is priced from £32.50pp on Monday - Friday, and £35pp on Saturday and Sunday.
